description:
Strongly-typed Avalonia theming. Decorate a class with [Theme], install this package, and the bundled Roslyn source generator emits one markup extension per public property, so your XAML binds theme values directly with full IntelliSense and no runtime code generation. Extensions sort into {color:...}, {size:...} and {theme:...} by the property's C# type.

ACCENTS. {color:AccentBrush} resolves against whichever hue the target control carries, so one accent style block serves every hue instead of a copy per accent. Callers write theme:Accent.Kind="Warning"; the hue inherits down into template parts. Hues and shades are inferred from the theme's own Color Accent{Hue} and Accent{Hue}{Shade}Brush properties, so adding a hue is a theme edit and nothing else.

ACCENT ROLES. [AccentRole] on a property whose constant RampStage value pins a stage generates {color:TextDefault} and {color:TextDefaultBrush}, resolving that stage against the target control's hue — a named token for recurring assignments like outlined text ink, retunable from one property. PinHue pins a role's hue, and per-hue policies (BrightStage, ContrastAgainst/Alternate, FocusColour/NeutralHue/FocusSwitch) resolve in the reactive binding. See the README.

ICONS. Mark a class [IconGallery] and every public string property becomes an {icons:IconName} extension.

PREVIEW STATES. theme:Preview.State="Hover" makes a control paint an interaction state without being interacted with, so a gallery or a spec page can show hover, pressed and focused side by side. Pair it with the real pseudo-class in one selector: ^:pointerover, ^[(theme|Preview.State)=Hover]. Being an attached property rather than a style class, an IDE resolves it and a typo is a compile error.

SCOPED REGIONS. theme:ThemeRegion.Theme pins a full alternate theme to a subtree while the rest of the app keeps the global one, and theme:ThemeRegion.IsDark="True" mirrors whichever base is in effect into its dark ramp; both inherit, so a container retints everything beneath it down into template parts.

STYLE CLASSES. A bundled MSBuild target generates the stub declarations that stop IDEs underlining Classes="accent" on markup that works, keeping them in step with your ControlThemes automatically. It is opt-in via GenerateStyleClassDeclarations=true.

DARK SEEDS. [ColorRamp(DarkSeed = "#RRGGBB")] re-points a ramp's dark half at a manual color instead of deriving it from the seed, so a brand color can hold its exact value in dark mode while light keeps stepping off the declared seed.

CANVAS RAMPS (1.19.0). Dark-palette Light stages step towards the canvas, not black; [ColorRamp(InvertRamp = true)] keeps the old direction.

HUE-AWARE RAMPS (1.20.0). [ColorRamp(HueAware = true)] gives stage N one OKLCH lightness in every opted-in hue; see the README.

CORNERS (1.28.0). theme:CornerFit.Enabled (inherited) draws an oversized radius as a perfect pill, never an oval, without changing the radius; {size:ConcentricCorners Padding=...} insets by padding too.

SIZE FLOOR (1.26.0). [SizeScale(Floor = 1)]: a step above 0 never drops below 1, so hairlines survive.

THEME HELPERS (1.25.0). Moved out of the AvaloniaThemeLab default theme so every theme gets them: {size:ConcentricCorners} (a corner radius concentric with a control's rounded outline, for a part drawn inside or around it), {color:AccentColor} (the Color twin of {color:AccentBrush}, for a Color slot), theme:Icon.Data / theme:Icon.Placement (an icon a button-like control draws beside its content), and the gallery markers theme:PreviewShownIn / theme:PreviewExcluded. Code inside an AngelSix.ThemeEngine.* namespace must now write Avalonia.Media.Colors.Red, not Colors.Red.

LIGHT INK ANCHORS (1.24.0). [ColorRamp(LightInk = [...])] declares hand-tuned light Dark stages that follow a live seed edit; see the README.

Bundles AngelSix.ThemeEngine.SourceGen as an analyzer: one install gives you the runtime, generator and build targets.
